topSignals.title: Oracle Project Jupiter: Dismiss-motion response filed today — hearing officer ruling now imminent
topSignals.text: — August 11 was the deadline for Yucca Growth Infrastructure to respond to New Energy Economy's motion to dismiss the Project Jupiter air quality permit application (2.45 GW Bloom SOFC, Santa Teresa NM). The developer's response enters the NMED public record today; the hearing officer will now rule on whether to dismiss outright or allow the process to continue to the September 14 public hearing. Dismissal would freeze proceedings indefinitely, as the twice-denied Energy Transfer pipeline is unavailable for refiling. Project Jupiter represents ~16% of total announced SOFC AI data center capacity. ABQ Journal | Santa Fe New Mexican | NMELC

topSignals.title: FERC RM26-4: T-6 days to August 17 tariff-reform hard deadline
topSignals.text: — PJM, MISO, NYISO, and SPP received binding "revise tariff" orders on August 8; their filings are now 6 days out. If all four file on schedule, the $5-20/MWh avoided-transmission-cost LCOE input activates simultaneously across the four largest US grid regions. CAISO is tracking a November compliance filing. ISO-NE's "Bring Your Own Generation" (BYOG) proposal, which would mandate on-site firm generation for new large-load data center interconnection in New England, remains pending. FERC RM26-4 docket | Akin — PJM tariff order | McGuireWoods

topSignals.title: Hedgehog USA Texas: 1.5 GW Bloom SOFC campus (Phase 1: 104 MW), construction reportedly starting August 2026 — first appearance
topSignals.text: — Hedgehog USA filed a Texas (TCEQ) air-standard-permit registration for 4,615 Bloom ES-6.5 server blocks, totaling approximately 1.5 GW. The filing describes a phased ramp: 104 MW → 300 MW → 800 MW → 1.5 GW. Phase 1 construction start reported August 2026 per the MLQ.ai fuel-cell deployment tracker. Texas ERCOT Batch Zero self-supply pathway exempts this project from the FERC interconnection queue — this is exactly the regulatory bypass structure that has made Texas the fastest-growing US SOFC market. Permit registration is an early-stage action; commercial operation confirmation pending. MLQ.ai fuel-cell buildout tracker

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet day August 11. Status unchanged: E3000 G2 — >75% FC electrical efficiency (stack-level LHV), 90% total with heat recovery, 23,000 rapid SOEC current cycles with performance improvement, zero thermal-cycling degradation (EFCF 2026 / ResearchGate paper). ELCO I Tallinn factory (360 MW/yr) in volume production delivering G2 stacks; €140M total funding secured. European Commission EVP Teresa Ribera visited ELCO I in June 2026, signaling EU-level strategic recognition. Next watch: full peer-reviewed EFCF paper and system-level efficiency confirmation at ELCO I production scale. Elcogen

Topsoe (priority): Quiet day August 11. Status unchanged: Herning SOEC factory (500 MW/yr) hibernated pending commercial-scale H2 demand recovery; CEO Elena Scaltritti (since June 1, 2026); FY2026 guidance DKK 7,600-8,400M revenue, EBIT margin 4-9%. SOFC/data-center pathway deferred to 2029+. No new SOFC product or partnership announcements. Topsoe

Other players: Quiet day. No new announcements from Bloom (technology), Ceres Power (stack), SolydEra, FuelCell Energy, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, or Aisin. Delta Electronics Q4 2026 Ceres Endura (10.8 kW) production ramp remains the nearest-term European-licensed SOFC commercialization event.

Hedgehog USA Texas (1.5 GW Bloom SOFC campus, Phase 1: 104 MW, August 2026 construction start, first appearance): See Top Signal #3. Adds a previously undisclosed mid-market SOFC project to the pipeline — confirming the addressable market for Bloom extends well beyond the named hyperscalers (Oracle, Nebius, Equinix) into unbranded or emerging data center operators. MLQ.ai fuel-cell buildout

Oracle Project Jupiter (2.45 GW, New Mexico) — dismiss-motion response deadline today. See Top Signal #1. No NMED ruling yet as of today. The hearing officer's ruling will determine whether the September 14 public hearing proceeds. ABQ Journal | NMELC

Active pipeline carry-forward: Bloom Energy + MiTAC Fremont AI server manufacturing campus islanded microgrid (~24 Bloom AI customers, ~250 MW total Bloom AI capacity); Crusoe/Cheyenne (900 MW Phase 1, first data halls H2 2026); FCEL/Fit Energy (380 MW total, 30 MW initial delivery H2 2026); Equinix >100 MW (19+ DCs); Bloom/Brookfield $25B EaaS framework; Nebius 328 MW EaaS; Delta Electronics Q4 2026 SOFC ramp (Ceres Endura).

FERC RM26-4 — T-6 days to August 17 hard deadline: See Top Signal #2. No new tariff filings confirmed today. Recap: PJM, MISO, NYISO, SPP received direct "revise tariff" orders (August 8); CAISO targeting November compliance filing; ISO-NE proposing BYOG mandate. August 17 remains the single most important near-term regulatory date for US on-site SOFC economics. FERC RM26-4

US states reconsidering data center tax breaks (August 2026 status, first consolidated digest entry) — At least 28 states introduced proposals in 2026 to restrict or repeal data center tax incentives. Eight states have enacted restrictions as of August 2026: Ohio (moratorium), Arizona (three-year moratorium through FY2029), Illinois (freeze on new agreements), North Carolina (electricity tax exemption repealed), New Jersey ($250M incentive program frozen), and Oklahoma (ratepayer protection legislation). Texas projected data center tax cost: $3.3B for the 2028-29 biennium — and growing. If Texas or Virginia enact restrictions, SOFC pipeline growth in these two dominant DC states could slow. Paradoxically, this may accelerate the shift to off-grid SOFC (which reduces dependence on grid-tied tax structures). Stateline.org | TechTimes August 3 | MultiState 2026 legislative tracker

Background unchanged: NY data center moratorium (50 MW+, EO 62, islanded exemption active); Germany EnEfG PUE <=1.2 / ERF >=10% / 15% waste heat reuse from July 2026; EU CADA energy efficiency rating scheme delayed; ITC 48E 30% credit active for all fuel cell feedstocks; ERCOT Batch Zero self-supply pathway active.

NuScale AI data center analysis (Motley Fool, August 10, first appearance) — A detailed market analysis confirms NuScale Power Modules cannot realistically serve data center power needs before the early 2030s at the earliest, despite an ~8% single-session stock gain on AI power demand sentiment. The analysis cites NRC licensing timelines, HALEU fuel supply chain gaps, and construction lead times as binding constraints — consistent with the Bulletin of Atomic Scientists (July 2026) assessment. NuScale confirmed an August 6 MoU with Curio and Framatome to evaluate a closed-loop nuclear fuel cycle, a preliminary step that does not advance commercial delivery timelines. Competitive implication: SOFCs face no nuclear competitor in the US before 2030. Motley Fool August 10 | Yahoo Finance same | Kalkine NuScale 8% rally

Background unchanged from August 10: Blue Energy/GE Vernova/Crusoe gas-to-nuclear 2.5 GW (Phase 1 gas 2030, BWRX-300 2032); Holtec/Entergy/Hyundai E&C dual SMR-300 MOA Gulf South (2033+); Microsoft TMI Unit 1 restart (835 MW, first electrons 2027 — grid restart); Meta/Oklo 1.2 GW Pike County OH (2030+); Microsoft Project Kilby 2.67 GW CCGT Texas (first power 2028); TVA/Kairos Power/Google 50 MW PPA (Hermes 2 FHR, 2030 first power). SOFC 90-day deployment advantage unchallenged through 2029.

Ceres Power (LON: CWR): Quiet day. Goldman Sachs August Conviction Buy (168% upside) unchanged. Delta Electronics Q4 2026 production ramp (Ceres Endura 10.8 kW) is the nearest execution catalyst before H1 2026 results (September). Ceres newsroom

PEM-H2 fuel cell catalyst breakthrough — Nature Nanotechnology (August 6, 2026), first appearance. A nanostructured carbon support with radially arranged pore channels retains 85% of peak performance after 150,000 harsh voltage cycles (~25,000 hours operational equivalent), overcoming the classical activity-stability trade-off in PEM catalysts. Published August 6 in Nature Nanotechnology; covered August 7-8 by ScienceDaily and Phys.org. Significance for SOFC positioning: this is a hydrogen PEM (not SOFC) breakthrough. No direct impact on current NG-SOFC LCOE. However, if commercialized, PEM-H2 durability improves to ~25,000 hours (from the current ~7,000-10,000 h commercial ceiling), reducing stack replacement cost and narrowing the PEM-H2 vs. NG-SOFC LCOE gap over the 2030+ horizon when green H2 prices decline. Monitor for commercialization timelines and follow-on scaling studies. ScienceDaily August 7 | Phys.org | EurekAlert
No new SOFC-specific patents or IP filings identified for August 11.

lcoe.text: Hedgehog USA Texas 104 MW Phase 1 (construction start August 2026): No capex or $/kW figures disclosed in the permit filing. Confirms Bloom SOFC addressable market extends to non-hyperscaler mid-market operators. If the 1.5 GW build-out materializes, add as a new pipeline entry. No LCOE model update until capex or PPA pricing is disclosed. MLQ.ai fuel-cell buildout

PEM-H2 catalyst durability (Nature Nanotechnology, August 6): ~25,000 hours retention at 85% performance, if commercialized. In a 2030 scenario with H2 at ~$3/kg (DOE Earthshot) and 25,000-hour PEM stacks, PEM-H2 LCOE could approach $18-22¢/kWh — narrowing the gap against NG-SOFC ($13-22¢/kWh) but still not definitively cheaper when considering NG-SOFC heat credit. Flag as a "2030+ PEM competitive scenario" sensitivity; no current model change. ScienceDaily

US state tax break rollbacks: Eight states enacted data center tax incentive restrictions in 2026 (none are major DC hubs yet). Texas data center tax cost: $3.3B projected for 2028-29. If Texas or Virginia enact restrictions, model a 10-20% downside adjustment to 2028-2030 Texas/Virginia SOFC pipeline projections. No current model update; monitor for 2026-27 Texas legislative action. TechTimes August 3

(4) Bloom 10-Q shipped MW extraction (SEC EDGAR, due September 11). (5) Elcogen E3000 G2 system-level efficiency at ELCO I production scale. (6) Scandium class action lead plaintiff deadline September 28. (7) Oracle Project Jupiter air permit hearing September 14 (conditional on dismiss denial). (8) Ceres H1 2026 results and Delta Electronics Q4 ramp confirmation (September). (9) Bloom Q3 2026 earnings (October).
